messages:
ryan: Heads-up — we're going to ramp ff:enable_new_routing from 0% -> 10% in eu-west during the 02:00 UTC change window. Plan: 10% -> 50% after 30m soak, then 100% after health gates.

amanda: @ryan please add the safety hold: 30m cooldown and an automatic hold if error_rate increase > 1.5% or p95 latency +200ms :eyes:

ryan: added. health gates: error_rate_delta <= 1.5%, p95_delta <= 200ms, no increase in 5xx spikes > 3 occurrences. If breached -> auto rollback to previous cohort and pin routing to v2.

deploy-bot: [info] canary started at 02:02 UTC -> cohort=10% eu-west. link: https://deploys.redwood/3245/canary

maria: Observability link shows a small spike in avg latency at +30s but within threshold. Keeping an eye. @sre-bot can you watch p95 and errors?

sre-bot: Monitoring enabled. Alert if error_rate_delta > 1.0% for 3 consecutive 1m intervals or p95 > 500ms.

sam: Quick note — we should pin model version for the cohort to avoid auto-upgrades. Use: redeployctl pin-model --service routing --version v2.7.1

kai: Suggest adding a manual hold command in case we need to pause ramp: /ff toggle --flag enable_new_routing --set 10% --hold "manual" (ops only)

amanda: +1, also logging runbook step: if we hit the hold, mute downstream workers and contact oncall (@kai) before rollback.

ryan: ok all, proceed with ramp. If no holds, schedule next increase to 50% at 02:35 UTC. I'll post post-deploy notes and update release notes with the flag config.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] next-step at 02:35 UTC. React :rocket: to acknowledge.

maria: :thumbsup:

amanda: :eyes:
